customers_overlap_at_counter.previous_customer_still_at_counter: The earlier customer remains at the same service counter.
customers_overlap_at_counter.different_customer_starts_document_prese: A different customer starts presenting a document there while the earlier customer is still at the counter; show before and after without identifying people.

cash_counting_without_customer.cash_is_identified: Visible currency-specific detail confirms banknotes, not documents.
cash_counting_without_customer.direct_customer_cash_receipt: Cash is visibly received directly from a customer, not internal processing.
cash_counting_without_customer.cashier_counts_received_cash: The cashier visibly counts that received cash.
cash_counting_without_customer.customer_zone_fully_visible: The whole relevant customer area is visible; an off-camera customer cannot be excluded otherwise.
cash_counting_without_customer.customer_absent_during_counting: The fully visible customer area is empty while that cash is being counted.

previous_cash_outside_storage.cash_is_identified: Currency-specific detail confirms banknotes, not documents.
previous_cash_outside_storage.previous_receipt_completed: The previous cash-receipt operation visibly finished. A person stepping aside alone is insufficient.
previous_cash_outside_storage.previous_cash_continuously_tracked: The same earlier cash is tracked without temporal gaps or occlusion. Sparse sampled frames cannot establish continuous tracking; use unclear.
previous_cash_outside_storage.current_customer_receipt_in_progress: Cash receipt from a different customer is visibly in progress.
previous_cash_outside_storage.previous_cash_remains_outside_storage: That same previously received cash remains outside storage during the new receipt.

key_left_in_safe_lock.cashier_left_workplace: The operator moves away from the safe; show before and after.
key_left_in_safe_lock.key_in_safe_lock_after_departure: A key is distinguishable in the safe lock after departure, not just a handle or reflection.

entrance_door_left_open.operator_enters_room: The operator enters through an identifiable entrance; show before and after.
entrance_door_left_open.entrance_remains_open_after_entry: That entrance door visibly remains open after entry.

personal_items_on_work_surface.operator_starts_work: Visible work starts at the workstation.
personal_items_on_work_surface.personal_bag_or_clothing_on_work_surface: A bag or outer clothing remains on that work surface during work; do not infer ownership or contents.

cash_container_left_on_work_surface.cash_removed_from_container: Visible banknotes are removed from a visible container; show before and after.
cash_container_left_on_work_surface.same_container_remains_on_work_surface: That same container remains on the work surface after removal.

workstation_left_with_screen_on.cashier_left_workplace: The same workstation operator moves away; show before and after.
workstation_left_with_screen_on.screen_on_after_departure: The same workstation screen visibly emits light after the operator leaves. Do not read its content or infer lock state.

safe_left_open.cashier_left_workplace: The operator moves away from the safe; show before and after.
safe_left_open.safe_open_after_departure: The safe door is visibly open after the operator moves away. A closed door or visible key alone is insufficient.

cash_on_desk_with_next_customer.banknotes_on_work_surface: Recognizable banknotes remain on the same work surface.
cash_on_desk_with_next_customer.different_customer_approaches: A different customer approaches that workstation while the previous customer departs or moves away; show before and after, without identifying people.
cash_on_desk_with_next_customer.banknotes_remain_during_approach: The same banknotes are still on the surface when the different customer approaches.

documents_left_unattended.cashier_left_workplace: The operator moves away from the workstation; show before and after.
documents_left_unattended.documents_remain_after_departure: Documents visibly remain on that workstation after departure. Do not read personal text.

customer_leaves_during_cash_check.customer_left_counter: The customer moves away from the counter; show before and after.
customer_leaves_during_cash_check.visible_cash_check_continues: Visible banknote counting or detector use continues at that departure. Do not infer a hidden transaction state.
